project_name: The Voynich Manuscript: 600 Years of Mystery
video_idea: A documentary exploring the Voynich Manuscript - an undeciphered medieval codex with botanical, pharmaceutical, and astronomical sections, and the centuries of failed attempts (from Renaissance scholars to WWII codebreakers to modern computational linguists) to crack its code
reference_channel_style: The Infographics Show style cinematic documentary, candlelit archival aesthetic
